why: Instrument defect found while building, before any measured run: the test injected the unknown head into guards[0].expr, a term the sort pass never walks (holon.sorts.extracted.action_records walks a guard through its reaches, never its own expr), so the 0.2 pass could not refuse it and the test could hold under no implementation. The injection moves to checks[0].expr (a term the pass walks, via the new helper first_check); the asserted debt entry's where follows (checks[0]). The rule F6 and the expected count (2) are unchanged.

Instrument fix found while building, before any measured run: config/holon.json is a read input of every Morph law record, so adding the toolchain sets there makes holon land dirty re-make Morph's whole law set ("inputs changed: read config/holon.json changed"), against the key's own regression I103-R1 and the M6 invariant. The sets move to a new file, config/toolchains.json, which no Morph law reads; the test reads them there. The expected releases, sha256s and the assertions on config/holon.json replay (unchanged) are the same.

I104 build: R4 left out a refusal the build needs. A proposed Go-op component that holon.diagram.goops cannot build (no op takes its carrier, or its carrier id is not an identifier) makes holon codecs exit 3, so the merged sidecar could never be derived from. holon roles therefore drops such a proposal, with the producer's reason under dropped, as it already drops a recompute role that holon.gox refuses. The test's buildable proposal now names a carrier with ops in the go_ops sidecar's own document (io.Reader), and its old unbuildable one (*planted.T) is asserted dropped. No threshold, prediction or measured outcome changes.

I104 build: the prereg's role-dependence rule (thresholds.role_dependent) counts every law over gen/M3/goops/, but that directory also holds holon.diagram.gocount's count components (l1_counts), which come from the hand sidecar spec/M3/lib/go_counts.json. holon roles does not generate that sidecar, so the laws over it are truthfully roles_source hand. The provenance assertion now expects hand for a gen/M3/goops/ document that is not a component of the generated go_ops.json, and for a link_domain law. It also counts subform link_domain, whose laws read none of the three generated role sidecars (they are byte-identical under --roles auto) and so are truthfully roles_source hand too. The rederivation counts and thresholds are unchanged (95 of 99 either way).
